name: Land Cruiser RJ77
years: documented production from at least 1991; broader run likely tracks the same c.1985-1996 window as other RJ codes
stock_transmission: 5-speed manual (one museum record lists '5F' - unclear if the same physical unit as RJ70's G52, or a distinct regional part code)
notes: Existence confirmed by an actual VIN'd museum unit (GCC/Middle East market) and an ih8mud for-sale listing. No factory weight/diff/tire data located for this specific code. Note: RJ75 was searched for and could NOT be verified as a real code - period parts catalogs consistently list the petrol RJ-series as just RJ70/RJ73/RJ77, so it was not added.
